Search the codebase at /tmp/ruflo for duplicated parsing, repeated path resolution, and whole-graph rebuilds. EXCLUDE /node_modules, /.git, /dist, /tests, *.test.ts, *.spec.ts.

Run these ripgrep commands and return ALL results with file:line and the matching line content:

1. `rg -n 'JSON\.parse\(' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts' -g '!*.spec.ts' | head -80`
2. `rg -n 'path\.resolve\(|path\.join\(' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts' -g '!*.spec.ts' | head -80`
3. `rg -n 'readFileSync\(|readFile\(' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts' -g '!*.spec.ts' | head -60`
4. `rg -n 'require\(.*tsconfig|readTsConfig|parseTsConfig|tsconfig' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts' -g '!*.spec.ts'`
5. `rg -n 'rebuild|reindex|recompute|re-build|re-index|fullRebuild|buildGraph|buildIndex' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts' -g '!*.spec.ts'`
6. Check plugin loader areas:
   `rg -rn 'plugin\.json|plugin\.manifest|manifest' /tmp/ruflo/v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/plugins 2>/dev/null | head -40`
   `rg -rn 'JSON\.parse' /tmp/ruflo/v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/plugins 2>/dev/null | head -40`
7. Check HNSW areas:
   `rg -rn 'rebuild|reindex|buildIndex|buildGraph' /tmp/ruflo/v3/@claude-flow/memory /tmp/ruflo/v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/memory 2>/dev/null`
   `rg -rn 'rebuild|reindex|buildIndex|buildGraph' /tmp/ruflo/v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/embeddings 2>/dev/null`

Return the raw rg output verbatim — every match line with file path and line number. Do NOT summarize or skip any matches. Do NOT read files yet, just return the grep hits.
